title: TURP (prostate surgery)
what: Working through the urethra, the surgeon removes part of the enlarged prostate that blocks urine flow. There are no cuts in the skin.
why: For an enlarged prostate when peeing is hard and medicines do not help, or after urine retention.
duration: surgery usually takes 1 to 1.5 hours, with 2 to 5 days in hospital
tell_doctor: All your medicines, especially blood thinners. Your doctor will say what to stop and when
Heart or lung disease, or diabetes
If you have a bladder catheter

prepare.title: Tests
prepare.text: Blood and urine tests, an ECG, an ultrasound, sometimes a GP checkup. The clinic will give you a list.

prepare.title: Anesthetist
prepare.text: Usually spinal anesthesia or general anesthesia. The anesthetist will discuss the options with you.

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: Usually no food from the night before and no drinks for a few hours. The clinic will tell you the exact time.

prepare.title: Things to pack
prepare.text: Comfortable clothes, slippers, a charger, and the medicines you take every day.

bring: Things for a hospital stay of a few days
steps: You change, and an IV line is placed
Anesthesia is given: your lower body goes numb, or you sleep
The surgeon passes a thin instrument with a camera through the urethra
Excess prostate tissue is removed piece by piece
At the end, a catheter is placed in the bladder
The bladder is flushed through the catheter, and urine may look pink
feel: An urge to pee because of the catheter. This is normal
Burning when peeing in the first days after the catheter comes out
after: The catheter usually comes out after 1 to 3 days
Drink plenty of water, unless your doctor says otherwise
A little blood in the urine can last a few weeks
No heavy lifting, cycling, or sex, usually for 4 to 6 weeks
Ejaculation often becomes dry. This is expected
red_flags: Urine turns bright red or has clots
Severe pain low in the belly: call emergency services

faq.q: Will I leak urine after surgery?
faq.a: At first, the urge to go may be frequent. This usually passes in a few weeks. Pelvic floor exercises help.
Semen goes into the bladder instead of out. Sensation usually stays the same, and it is not harmful.

reminders.text: Prostate surgery tomorrow. Pack your things, documents, and medicine list. Eat and drink only until the time the clinic gave you.
